- **Quick, nothing changes in the repo:** run `! nvm install 24.22.0`. Afterwards `node -v` should work here.
- **Change the repo:** set `.nvmrc` to `24.22.2`, the version you already have installed. The perf baseline only compares the Node major version (24), so it doesn't need updating. This would go in a small PR of its own, along the lines of `chore(tools): bump .nvmrc to 24.22.2`.

git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
chore(tools): pin .nvmrc to the Node 24 major instead of a patch release

An exact patch release in .nvmrc breaks nvm wherever that release isn't
installed. "24" takes the newest 24.x in setup-node, nvm and nvm-windows
alike (a "^24" range is not understood by nvm on the Nx Cloud workers).
The cloud session check now compares the major only.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git push -u origin chore/nvmrc-node-24 2>&1 | tail -2 && gh pr create --title "chore(tools): pin .nvmrc to the Node 24 major" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary
- `.nvmrc`: `24.22.0` → `24`. An exact patch release fails locally whenever that release isn't installed (nvm-windows: `Node.js v24.22.0 is not installed`). `24` resolves to the newest 24.x in `actions/setup-node`, nvm (Nx Cloud workers' `install-node` step) and nvm-windows. A `^24` range was considered, but nvm on the workers doesn't understand ranges.
- `tools/claude-cloud/session-start.sh`: compares only the major, so the warning no longer fires on any 24.x.
- `docs/GETTING_STARTED.md`: stated Node 20.x, now 24.x.

The perf baseline only compares the Node major, so it is unaffected.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)" && gh pr comment --body "@coderabbitai review" >/dev/null && echo commented
